# Bitplaza

> Bitplaza is the open map for communities: a community's people, knowledge,
> projects, events, and opportunities brought into one open, navigable map.
> It is operated by Bitcoin Culture Hub and lives at https://joinbitplaza.com.
> The first map is Bitcoin. The site is pre-launch: today it offers a waitlist
> with email confirmation, a community-leader application, and documentation
> of what is being built.

Disambiguation: Bitplaza at joinbitplaza.com is not affiliated with the
mobile shopping app of the same name.

Bitplaza is part of a family of platforms serving global communities:
Kids Table (talent development), CLCT (commerce, https://clctibles.com), and
Bitcoin Culture Hub (community infrastructure, https://bitcoinculturehub.com).

The source code is public under AGPL-3.0:
https://github.com/bucketbuckets/bitplaza

## Pages

- [Home](https://joinbitplaza.com): what Bitplaza is, the platform family, and the waitlist
- [Explore Bitcoin](https://joinbitplaza.com/bitcoin): the first map — eleven territories with marked starting points
- [For communities](https://joinbitplaza.com/communities): what community leaders get, and the application
- [Open Source](https://joinbitplaza.com/open): the public repository, the AGPL-3.0 license, and what remains under development
- [About](https://joinbitplaza.com/about): why Bitplaza exists
- [Questions](https://joinbitplaza.com/questions): frequently asked questions
- [Privacy](https://joinbitplaza.com/privacy): the privacy policy
- [Terms](https://joinbitplaza.com/terms): the terms of use
